scope: Oscilloscope and logic-capture pipeline before OPT-007

observations.workerBuffer: An array retains up to 4096 per-substep frame objects and removes the oldest frame with shift
observations.workerPayload: OSCILLOSCOPE posts an array of timestamp and channel-record objects without transferable numeric buffers
observations.enginePublication: SimulationEngine loops every frame and channel, calling one scope store action per channel and one logic action per frame
observations.scopeRetention: Each appended channel sample copies and may slice its retained array
observations.logicRetention: Each appended logic frame copies and slices the retained logic array
observations.timebaseRouting: Time-per-division is panel-local state and does not influence worker capture cadence
observations.manualStepDelivery: A paused REQUEST_RESULT can consume the result credit before STEP publishes its newly solved state

limitation: Browser publication counts, ring-wrap traces, and protocol-decoder captures were unavailable; validate cadence, bounded retention, pause/step ordering, and protocol edges through OPT-FB-007.
